newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai interbank rate falls, baht eases late.
newsitem.headline: Thai interbank rate falls, baht eases late.

text.p: The Thai overnight interbank rate fell to 13.00 percent in late trade on Thursday from 13.50-13.75 percent earlier and 13.75-14.00 late on Wednesday on higher liquidity, dealers said.
"The interbank rate is likely to ease further. We may see the interbank rate at 12.00 percent tomorrow," said one dealer at a European bank.
The baht fell to 25.406-25.409 to the dollar late from 25.395-25.398 early and 25.360-25.365 late on Wednesday on the dollar's strength abroad, dealers said.
